title: Update `port_config.ini` for `Arista-720DT-48S`
author: lizhijianrd
body:
#### Description



`port_config.ini` of `Arista-720DT-48S` is using `Ethernet1`\~`Ethernet52` as alias now. According to [SONiC port naming convention change](https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/blob/master/doc/sonic-port-name.md), we need to update it to `etp1`\~`etp52`.

comments.author: andywongarista
comments.body: Hi Zhijian, yes this was something that we had meant to do. We will look into updating it now.
